local function split(s, separator)
    local list, start = {}, 1
    while true do
        local at = s:find(separator, start, true)
        if not at then
            list[#list + 1] = s:sub(start)
            break
        end
        list[#list + 1], start = s:sub(start, at - 1), at + #separator
    end
    return list
end
local function copy(t)
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        result[k] = v
    end
    return result
end
local function contains(s, ...)
    for _, v in ipairs({...}) do
        if s == v then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function unsigned(s)
    return #s >= 1 and #s <= 3 and s:match("^[0-9]+$") ~= nil
end
local function positive(s)
    return unsigned(s) and tonumber(s) > 0
end
local function signed(s)
    return unsigned(s) or s:sub(1, 1) == "-" and unsigned(s:sub(2))
end
local function percentage(s)
    return s:sub(-1) == "%" and unsigned(s:sub(1, -2))
end
local function sum(list, first, last)
    local value = 0
    for i = first or 1, last or #list do
        value = value + list[i]
    end
    return value
end
local initial = {
    display = "block",
    position = "static",
    ["box-sizing"] = "content-box",
    width = "auto",
    height = "auto",
    ["min-width"] = "0",
    ["min-height"] = "0",
    ["max-width"] = "none",
    ["max-height"] = "none",
    top = "auto",
    right = "auto",
    bottom = "auto",
    left = "auto",
    ["flex-direction"] = "row",
    ["flex-wrap"] = "nowrap",
    ["justify-content"] = "start",
    ["align-items"] = "stretch",
    ["align-self"] = "auto",
    ["row-gap"] = "0",
    ["column-gap"] = "0",
    order = "0",
    ["flex-grow"] = "0",
    ["flex-shrink"] = "1",
    ["flex-basis"] = "auto",
    ["grid-template-columns"] = "none",
    ["grid-template-rows"] = "none",
    ["grid-column"] = "auto",
    ["grid-row"] = "auto"
}
for _, prefix in ipairs({"margin", "padding", "border"}) do
    for _, side in ipairs({"top", "right", "bottom", "left"}) do
        initial[prefix .. "-" .. side] = "0"
    end
end
local function gridValue(value)
    local p = split(value, " ")
    if #p == 1 then
        return p[1] == "auto" or positive(p[1])
    end
    if #p == 2 then
        return p[1] == "span" and positive(p[2])
    end
    if #p == 3 then
        return positive(p[1]) and p[2] == "/" and positive(p[3]) and tonumber(p[1]) < tonumber(p[3])
    end
    return #p == 4 and positive(p[1]) and p[2] == "/" and p[3] == "span" and positive(p[4])
end
local function valid(property, value)
    local parts = split(value, " ")
    if contains(property, "margin", "padding", "border", "gap") then
        if #parts < 1 or #parts > (property == "gap" and 2 or 4) then
            return nil
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
            if not unsigned(part) or property == "border" and not contains(part, "0", "1") then
                return nil
            end
        end
        if property == "gap" then
            return {{"row-gap", parts[1]}, {"column-gap", parts[2] or parts[1]}}
        end
        local values = {
            parts[1],
            parts[2] or parts[1],
            parts[3] or parts[1],
            parts[4] or parts[2] or parts[1]
        }
        local result = {}
        for i, side in ipairs({"top", "right", "bottom", "left"}) do
            result[#result + 1] = {property .. "-" .. side, values[i]}
        end
        return result
    end
    if not initial[property] then
        return nil
    end
    local good = false
    if property:sub(1, 14) == "grid-template-" then
        good = value == "none"
        if not good then
            good = true
            for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                if
                    not unsigned(part) and part ~= "auto" and
                        not (part:sub(-2) == "fr" and positive(part:sub(1, -3)))
                 then
                    good = false
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    elseif property == "grid-column" or property == "grid-row" then
        good = gridValue(value)
    elseif #parts == 1 then
        if property == "display" then
            good = contains(value, "block", "flex", "grid", "none")
        elseif property == "position" then
            good = contains(value, "static", "relative", "absolute")
        elseif property == "box-sizing" then
            good = contains(value, "content-box", "border-box")
        elseif contains(property, "width", "height", "flex-basis") then
            good = value == "auto" or unsigned(value) or percentage(value)
        elseif contains(property, "min-width", "min-height") then
            good = unsigned(value) or percentage(value)
        elseif contains(property, "max-width", "max-height") then
            good = value == "none" or unsigned(value) or percentage(value)
        elseif contains(property, "top", "right", "bottom", "left") then
            good = value == "auto" or signed(value)
        elseif property == "flex-direction" then
            good = contains(value, "row", "row-reverse", "column", "column-reverse")
        elseif property == "flex-wrap" then
            good = contains(value, "nowrap", "wrap")
        elseif property == "justify-content" then
            good =
                contains(
                value,
                "start",
                "end",
                "center",
                "space-between",
                "space-around",
                "space-evenly"
            )
        elseif property == "align-items" then
            good = contains(value, "stretch", "start", "end", "center")
        elseif property == "align-self" then
            good = contains(value, "auto", "stretch", "start", "end", "center")
        elseif property == "order" then
            good = signed(value)
        elseif property:sub(1, 7) == "border-" then
            good = contains(value, "0", "1")
        else
            good = unsigned(value)
        end
    end
    return good and {{property, value}} or nil
end
local Element = {}
Element.__index = Element
function Element:n(property)
    return tonumber(self.style[property])
end
function Element:frame(horizontal)
    if horizontal then
        return self:n("padding-left") + self:n("padding-right") + self:n("border-left") +
            self:n("border-right")
    end
    return self:n("padding-top") + self:n("padding-bottom") + self:n("border-top") +
        self:n("border-bottom")
end
function Element:margin(horizontal)
    if horizontal then
        return self:n("margin-left") + self:n("margin-right")
    end
    return self:n("margin-top") + self:n("margin-bottom")
end
function Element:resolve(property, reference, horizontal)
    local value = self.style[property]
    if value == "auto" or value == "none" then
        return nil
    end
    local n
    if value:sub(-1) == "%" then
        if reference == nil then
            return nil
        end
        n = reference * tonumber(value:sub(1, -2)) // 100
    else
        n = tonumber(value)
    end
    if self.style["box-sizing"] == "border-box" then
        n = math.max(0, n - self:frame(horizontal))
    end
    return n
end
function Element:clamp(value, reference, horizontal)
    local axis = horizontal and "width" or "height"
    local lower, upper =
        self:resolve("min-" .. axis, reference, horizontal),
        self:resolve("max-" .. axis, reference, horizontal)
    if upper then
        value = math.min(value, upper)
    end
    return math.max(value, lower or 0)
end
function Element:flow()
    local result = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(self.children) do
        if child.displayed and child.style.position ~= "absolute" then
            result[#result + 1] = child
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Element:items()
    local list = self:flow()
    table.sort(
        list,
        function(a, b)
            return a:n("order") < b:n("order") or a:n("order") == b:n("order") and a.index < b.index
        end
    )
    return list
end
function Element:align(parent)
    return self.style["align-self"] == "auto" and parent.style["align-items"] or
        self.style["align-self"]
end
function Element:border()
    return {self.x, self.y, self.cw + self:frame(true), self.ch + self:frame(false)}
end
function Element:content()
    return {
        self.x + self:n("border-left") + self:n("padding-left"),
        self.y + self:n("border-top") + self:n("padding-top"),
        self.cw,
        self.ch
    }
end
function Element:marginBox()
    local r = self:border()
    return {
        r[1] - self:n("margin-left"),
        r[2] - self:n("margin-top"),
        r[3] + self:margin(true),
        r[4] + self:margin(false)
    }
end
local function distribute(total, weights)
    local result, totalWeight, used = {}, sum(weights), 0
    for i, weight in ipairs(weights) do
        result[i] = totalWeight > 0 and total * weight // totalWeight or 0
        used = used + result[i]
    end
    for i, weight in ipairs(weights) do
        if used == total then
            break
        end
        if weight > 0 then
            result[i], used = result[i] + 1, used + 1
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function gridSpec(value)
    local p = split(value, " ")
    if value == "auto" then
        return 0, 1
    end
    if p[1] == "span" then
        return 0, tonumber(p[2])
    end
    local start = tonumber(p[1])
    if #p == 1 then
        return start, 1
    end
    return start, #p == 3 and tonumber(p[3]) - start or tonumber(p[4])
end
local function tracks(value, columns)
    if value == "none" then
        return columns and {{kind = "auto", value = 0}} or {}
    end
    local result = {}
    for _, word in ipairs(split(value, " ")) do
        local t = {kind = "fixed", value = tonumber(word)}
        if word == "auto" then
            t.kind = "auto"
        elseif word:sub(-2) == "fr" then
            t.kind, t.value = "fr", tonumber(word:sub(1, -3))
        end
        result[#result + 1] = t
    end
    return result
end
local D = {rules = {}, elements = {}, byID = {}, output = {}}
function D:emit(format, ...)
    self.output[#self.output + 1] = string.format(format, ...)
end
function D:placement(e)
    local columns, rows, items =
        #tracks(e.style["grid-template-columns"], true),
        #tracks(e.style["grid-template-rows"], false),
        {}
    for _, child in ipairs(e:items()) do
        local c, cs = gridSpec(child.style["grid-column"])
        local r, rs = gridSpec(child.style["grid-row"])
        items[#items + 1] = {e = child, row = r, col = c, rows = rs, cols = cs}
        columns = math.max(columns, c > 0 and c + cs - 1 or cs)
    end
    local occupied = {}
    local function overlaps(p, r, c)
        for y = r, r + p.rows - 1 do
            for x = c, c + p.cols - 1 do
                if occupied[y .. ":" .. x] then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function mark(p)
        for y = p.row, p.row + p.rows - 1 do
            for x = p.col, p.col + p.cols - 1 do
                occupied[y .. ":" .. x] = true
            end
        end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(items) do
        if p.row > 0 and p.col > 0 then
            mark(p)
        end
    end
    local cr, cc = 1, 1
    for _, p in ipairs(items) do
        if p.row == 0 or p.col == 0 then
            if p.row > 0 then
                p.col = 1
                for c = 1, columns - p.cols + 1 do
                    if not overlaps(p, p.row, c) then
                        p.col = c
                        break
                    end
                end
            elseif p.col > 0 then
                if p.col < cc then
                    cr = cr + 1
                end
                local r = cr
                while overlaps(p, r, p.col) do
                    r = r + 1
                end
                p.row, cr, cc = r, r, p.col + p.cols
            else
                local r, c = cr, cc
                while true do
                    if c + p.cols - 1 > columns then
                        r, c = r + 1, 1
                    elseif overlaps(p, r, c) then
                        c = c + 1
                    else
                        break
                    end
                end
                p.row, p.col, cr, cc = r, c, r, c + p.cols
            end
            mark(p)
        end
        rows = math.max(rows, p.row + p.rows - 1)
    end
    return items, columns, rows
end
local function trackSizes(spec, count, available, gap, items, contributions, horizontal)
    local sizes, weights, kinds, hasFR = {}, {}, {}, false
    for i = 1, count do
        local t = spec[i] or {kind = "auto", value = 0}
        sizes[i], weights[i], kinds[i] = 0, 0, t.kind
        if t.kind == "fixed" then
            sizes[i] = t.value
        elseif t.kind == "auto" or available == nil then
            for j, p in ipairs(items) do
                local start, span = horizontal and p.col or p.row, horizontal and p.cols or p.rows
                if start == i and span == 1 then
                    sizes[i] = math.max(sizes[i], contributions[j])
                end
            end
        end
        if t.kind == "fr" then
            weights[i], hasFR = t.value, true
        end
    end
    if available ~= nil and count > 0 then
        local left = available - sum(sizes) - gap * (count - 1)
        if left > 0 then
            if not hasFR then
                for i, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
                    if kind == "auto" then
                        weights[i] = 1
                    end
                end
            end
            local extra = distribute(left, weights)
            for i = 1, count do
                sizes[i] = sizes[i] + extra[i]
            end
        end
    end
    return sizes
end
function D:contribution(e)
    local width = e:resolve("width", nil, true)
    return e:clamp(width or self:maxContent(e), nil, true) + e:frame(true) + e:margin(true)
end
function D:maxContent(e)
    if e.text then
        return #e.text
    end
    local children = e:flow()
    if e.style.display == "flex" and e.style["flex-direction"]:sub(1, 3) == "row" then
        local value = 0
        for _, child in ipairs(children) do
            value = value + self:contribution(child)
        end
        return value + (#children > 0 and e:n("column-gap") * (#children - 1) or 0)
    elseif e.style.display == "grid" then
        local items, nc = self:placement(e)
        local values = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(items) do
            values[i] = self:contribution(p.e)
        end
        return sum(
            trackSizes(
                tracks(e.style["grid-template-columns"], true),
                nc,
                nil,
                e:n("column-gap"),
                items,
                values,
                true
            )
        ) +
            e:n("column-gap") * (nc - 1)
    end
    local value = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(children) do
        value = math.max(value, self:contribution(child))
    end
    return value
end
local function wrap(text, width)
    local lines = {}
    for _, word in ipairs(split(text, " ")) do
        if #lines == 0 or #lines[#lines] + 1 + #word > width then
            lines[#lines + 1] = word
        else
            lines[#lines] = lines[#lines] .. " " .. word
        end
    end
    return lines
end
function D:layoutElement(e, cw, ch, fw, fh)
    e.cw = fw
    if fw == nil then
        e.cw =
            e:clamp(
            e:resolve("width", cw, true) or math.max(0, cw - e:margin(true) - e:frame(true)),
            cw,
            true
        )
    end
    if fh == nil then
        local h = e:resolve("height", ch, false)
        if h then
            fh = e:clamp(h, ch, false)
        end
    end
    local a = 0
    e.lines = {}
    if e.text then
        e.lines = wrap(e.text, e.cw)
        a = #e.lines
    elseif e.style.display == "flex" then
        a = self:flex(e, fh, ch)
    elseif e.style.display == "grid" then
        a = self:grid(e, fh)
    else
        a = self:block(e, fh)
    end
    e.ch = fh or e:clamp(a, ch, false)
    return a
end
local function position(e, child, x, y)
    child.rx, child.ry =
        x + e:n("border-left") + e:n("padding-left"),
        y + e:n("border-top") + e:n("padding-top")
end
function D:block(e, k)
    local bottom, previous, count = 0, 0, 0
    for _, child in ipairs(e:flow()) do
        self:layoutElement(child, e.cw, k)
        local y = child:n("margin-top")
        if count > 0 then
            y = bottom + math.max(previous, y)
        end
        position(e, child, child:n("margin-left"), y)
        bottom, previous, count =
            y + child.ch + child:frame(false),
            child:n("margin-bottom"),
            count + 1
    end
    return count > 0 and bottom + previous or 0
end
function D:flex(e, k, ch)
    local horizontal = e.style["flex-direction"]:sub(1, 3) == "row"
    local reversed = e.style["flex-direction"]:sub(-7) == "reverse"
    local mainRef = horizontal and e.cw or k
    local gap = e:n(horizontal and "column-gap" or "row-gap")
    local items = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(e:items()) do
        local item = {e = child, outer = child:frame(horizontal) + child:margin(horizontal)}
        if not horizontal then
            local r = math.max(0, e.cw - child:margin(true) - child:frame(true))
            local c = r
            if child.style.width ~= "auto" then
                c = child:resolve("width", e.cw, true)
            elseif child:align(e) ~= "stretch" then
                c = math.min(self:maxContent(child), r)
            end
            item.cross = child:clamp(c, e.cw, true)
        end
        item.base =
            child:resolve("flex-basis", mainRef, horizontal) or
            child:resolve(horizontal and "width" or "height", mainRef, horizontal)
        if item.base == nil then
            item.base =
                horizontal and self:maxContent(child) or
                self:layoutElement(child, e.cw, k, item.cross)
        end
        item.hypothetical = child:clamp(item.base, mainRef, horizontal)
        items[#items + 1] = item
    end
    local length = horizontal and e.cw or k
    if length == nil then
        length = 0
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            length = length + item.hypothetical + item.outer
        end
        length = e:clamp(length + (#items > 0 and gap * (#items - 1) or 0), ch, false)
    end
    local lines, used = {}, 0
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if #lines == 0 then
            lines[1] = {}
            used = 0
        end
        if
            horizontal and e.style["flex-wrap"] == "wrap" and #lines[#lines] > 0 and
                used + gap + item.hypothetical + item.outer > length
         then
            lines[#lines + 1] = {}
            used = 0
        end
        if #lines[#lines] > 0 then
            used = used + gap
        end
        lines[#lines][#lines[#lines] + 1] = item
        used = used + item.hypothetical + item.outer
    end
    local crossStart, totalCross = 0, 0
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local gaps = gap * (#line - 1)
        local hypothetical = gaps
        for _, item in ipairs(line) do
            hypothetical = hypothetical + item.hypothetical + item.outer
        end
        local growing = hypothetical < length
        for _, item in ipairs(line) do
            item.weight = growing and item.e:n("flex-grow") or item.e:n("flex-shrink") * item.base
            item.frozen =
                item.weight == 0 or growing and item.base > item.hypothetical or
                not growing and item.base < item.hypothetical
            item.size = item.hypothetical
        end
        while true do
            local free, weights, unfrozen = length - gaps, {}, 0
            for i, item in ipairs(line) do
                weights[i] = 0
                if item.frozen then
                    free = free - item.size - item.outer
                else
                    free = free - item.base - item.outer
                    weights[i], unfrozen = item.weight, unfrozen + 1
                end
            end
            if unfrozen == 0 then
                break
            end
            local assignments = distribute(math.max(0, growing and free or -free), weights)
            local violations, totalViolation = {}, 0
            for i, item in ipairs(line) do
                if not item.frozen then
                    local tentative = item.base + (growing and assignments[i] or -assignments[i])
                    item.size = item.e:clamp(tentative, mainRef, horizontal)
                    violations[i] = item.size - tentative
                    totalViolation = totalViolation + violations[i]
                end
            end
            for i, item in ipairs(line) do
                if
                    not item.frozen and
                        (totalViolation == 0 or totalViolation > 0 and violations[i] > 0 or
                            totalViolation < 0 and violations[i] < 0)
                 then
                    item.frozen = true
                end
            end
        end
        local lc = e.cw
        if horizontal then
            lc = 0
            for _, item in ipairs(line) do
                self:layoutElement(item.e, e.cw, k, item.size)
                item.cross = item.e.ch
                lc = math.max(lc, item.cross + item.e:frame(false) + item.e:margin(false))
            end
            if #lines == 1 then
                lc = k or e:clamp(lc, ch, false)
            end
        end
        local remaining, spaces = length - gaps, {}
        for i, item in ipairs(line) do
            remaining = remaining - item.size - item.outer
            spaces[i] = 0
        end
        local justify = e.style["justify-content"]
        if remaining > 0 then
            if justify == "end" then
                spaces[1] = remaining
            elseif justify == "center" then
                spaces[1] = remaining // 2
            elseif contains(justify, "space-between", "space-around", "space-evenly") then
                local weights = {}
                for i = 1, #line + 1 do
                    if justify == "space-between" then
                        weights[i] = (i == 1 or i == #line + 1) and 0 or 1
                    elseif justify == "space-around" then
                        weights[i] = (i == 1 or i == #line + 1) and 1 or 2
                    else
                        weights[i] = 1
                    end
                end
                local values = distribute(remaining, weights)
                for i = 1, #line do
                    spaces[i] = values[i]
                end
            end
        end
        local cursor = 0
        for i, item in ipairs(line) do
            local child, c = item.e, item.cross
            local align = child:align(e)
            if horizontal then
                if align == "stretch" and child.style.height == "auto" then
                    c =
                        child:clamp(
                        math.max(0, lc - child:frame(false) - child:margin(false)),
                        k,
                        false
                    )
                    self:layoutElement(child, e.cw, k, item.size, c)
                else
                    self:layoutElement(child, e.cw, k, item.size)
                    c = child.ch
                end
            else
                self:layoutElement(child, e.cw, k, c, item.size)
            end
            local q = lc - c - child:frame(not horizontal) - child:margin(not horizontal)
            local offset =
                q > 0 and (align == "end" and q or align == "center" and q // 2 or 0) or 0
            cursor = cursor + spaces[i]
            local side =
                horizontal and (reversed and "right" or "left") or (reversed and "bottom" or "top")
            local main =
                reversed and
                length - cursor - child:n("margin-" .. side) - item.size - child:frame(horizontal) or
                cursor + child:n("margin-" .. side)
            local cross =
                offset + child:n(horizontal and "margin-top" or "margin-left") +
                (horizontal and crossStart or 0)
            if horizontal then
                position(e, child, main, cross)
            else
                position(e, child, cross, main)
            end
            cursor = cursor + item.size + item.outer + gap
        end
        crossStart, totalCross = crossStart + lc + e:n("row-gap"), totalCross + lc
    end
    if not horizontal then
        return length
    end
    return totalCross + (#lines > 0 and e:n("row-gap") * (#lines - 1) or 0)
end
local function area(sizes, start, span, gap)
    return sum(sizes, start, start + span - 1) + gap * (span - 1), sum(sizes, 1, start - 1) +
        gap * (start - 1)
end
function D:grid(e, k)
    local items, nc, nr = self:placement(e)
    local contributions, widths, positions, actual = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for i, p in ipairs(items) do
        contributions[i] = self:contribution(p.e)
    end
    local columns =
        trackSizes(
        tracks(e.style["grid-template-columns"], true),
        nc,
        e.cw,
        e:n("column-gap"),
        items,
        contributions,
        true
    )
    for i, p in ipairs(items) do
        local aw, ax = area(columns, p.col, p.cols, e:n("column-gap"))
        local gw =
            p.e:clamp(
            p.e:resolve("width", aw, true) or math.max(0, aw - p.e:margin(true) - p.e:frame(true)),
            aw,
            true
        )
        widths[i], positions[i], actual[i] = aw, ax, gw
        self:layoutElement(p.e, aw, nil, gw)
        contributions[i] = p.e.ch + p.e:frame(false) + p.e:margin(false)
    end
    local rows =
        trackSizes(
        tracks(e.style["grid-template-rows"], false),
        nr,
        k,
        e:n("row-gap"),
        items,
        contributions,
        false
    )
    for i, p in ipairs(items) do
        local ah, ay = area(rows, p.row, p.rows, e:n("row-gap"))
        local child, fh = p.e, nil
        if child:align(e) == "stretch" and child.style.height == "auto" then
            fh = child:clamp(math.max(0, ah - child:frame(false) - child:margin(false)), ah, false)
        end
        self:layoutElement(child, widths[i], ah, actual[i], fh)
        local q, align = ah - child.ch - child:frame(false) - child:margin(false), child:align(e)
        local offset = q > 0 and (align == "end" and q or align == "center" and q // 2 or 0) or 0
        position(
            e,
            child,
            positions[i] + child:n("margin-left"),
            ay + offset + child:n("margin-top")
        )
    end
    return nr == 0 and 0 or sum(rows) + e:n("row-gap") * (nr - 1)
end
function D:layout()
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        e.style = copy(initial)
        local specificities = {}
        for _, rule in ipairs(self.rules) do
            local specificity = -1
            for _, selector in ipairs(rule.selectors) do
                if selector:sub(1, 1) == "#" then
                    if e.id == selector:sub(2) then
                        specificity = math.max(specificity, 2)
                    end
                elseif selector:sub(1, 1) == "." then
                    if e.classes[selector:sub(2)] then
                        specificity = math.max(specificity, 1)
                    end
                elseif e.kind == selector then
                    specificity = math.max(specificity, 0)
                end
            end
            if specificity >= 0 then
                for _, decl in ipairs(rule.declarations) do
                    if specificities[decl[1]] == nil or specificity >= specificities[decl[1]] then
                        e.style[decl[1]], specificities[decl[1]] = decl[2], specificity
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for p, v in pairs(e.inline) do
            e.style[p] = v
        end
        e.displayed, e.containing =
            e.style.display ~= "none" and (not e.parent or e.parent.displayed),
            nil
    end
    local root = self.elements[1]
    if root.displayed and root.style.position ~= "absolute" then
        self:layoutElement(root, self.width, self.height)
        root.rx, root.ry = root:n("margin-left"), root:n("margin-top")
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.displayed and e.style.position == "absolute" then
            local ancestor = e.parent
            while ancestor and ancestor.style.position == "static" do
                ancestor = ancestor.parent
            end
            e.containing = ancestor
            local cbw, cbh = self.width, self.height
            if ancestor then
                cbw, cbh =
                    ancestor.cw + ancestor:n("padding-left") + ancestor:n("padding-right"),
                    ancestor.ch + ancestor:n("padding-top") + ancestor:n("padding-bottom")
            end
            local w = e:resolve("width", cbw, true)
            if w == nil then
                local r =
                    math.max(
                    0,
                    cbw - (e.style.left ~= "auto" and e:n("left") or 0) -
                        (e.style.right ~= "auto" and e:n("right") or 0) -
                        e:margin(true) -
                        e:frame(true)
                )
                w =
                    e.style.left ~= "auto" and e.style.right ~= "auto" and r or
                    math.min(self:maxContent(e), r)
            end
            w = e:clamp(w, cbw, true)
            local fh
            if e.style.height == "auto" and e.style.top ~= "auto" and e.style.bottom ~= "auto" then
                fh =
                    e:clamp(
                    math.max(0, cbh - e:n("top") - e:n("bottom") - e:margin(false) - e:frame(false)),
                    cbh,
                    false
                )
            end
            self:layoutElement(e, cbw, cbh, w, fh)
            e.rx =
                e.style.left ~= "auto" and e:n("left") + e:n("margin-left") or
                e.style.right ~= "auto" and
                    cbw - e:n("right") - e:n("margin-right") - e.cw - e:frame(true) or
                e:n("margin-left")
            e.ry =
                e.style.top ~= "auto" and e:n("top") + e:n("margin-top") or
                e.style.bottom ~= "auto" and
                    cbh - e:n("bottom") - e:n("margin-bottom") - e.ch - e:frame(false) or
                e:n("margin-top")
        end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.displayed then
            local x, y = 0, 0
            if e.style.position == "absolute" then
                if e.containing then
                    x, y =
                        e.containing.x + e.containing:n("border-left"),
                        e.containing.y + e.containing:n("border-top")
                end
            elseif e.parent then
                x, y = e.parent.x, e.parent.y
            end
            e.x, e.y = x + e.rx, y + e.ry
            if e.style.position == "relative" then
                e.x =
                    e.x +
                    (e.style.left ~= "auto" and e:n("left") or
                        e.style.right ~= "auto" and -e:n("right") or
                        0)
                e.y =
                    e.y +
                    (e.style.top ~= "auto" and e:n("top") or
                        e.style.bottom ~= "auto" and -e:n("bottom") or
                        0)
            end
        end
    end
end
function D:snapshot()
    local result = {}
    for i, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        result[i] = e.displayed and table.concat(e:border(), ":") or "none"
    end
    return result
end
function D:changed(before)
    local after, names = self:snapshot(), {}
    for i, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if before[i] ~= after[i] then
            names[#names + 1] = e.id
        end
    end
    return #names > 0 and table.concat(names, " ") or "no change"
end
function D:render()
    local screen = {}
    for y = 0, self.height - 1 do
        screen[y] = {}
        for x = 0, self.width - 1 do
            screen[y][x] = "."
        end
    end
    local function draw(x, y, c)
        if x >= 0 and x < self.width and y >= 0 and y < self.height then
            screen[y][x] = c
        end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.displayed then
            local r = e:border()
            for y = math.max(0, r[2]), math.min(self.height, r[2] + r[4]) - 1 do
                for x = math.max(0, r[1]), math.min(self.width, r[1] + r[3]) - 1 do
                    local horizontal =
                        e:n("border-top") == 1 and y == r[2] or
                        e:n("border-bottom") == 1 and y == r[2] + r[4] - 1
                    local vertical =
                        e:n("border-left") == 1 and x == r[1] or
                        e:n("border-right") == 1 and x == r[1] + r[3] - 1
                    draw(
                        x,
                        y,
                        horizontal and vertical and "+" or horizontal and "-" or vertical and "|" or
                            " "
                    )
                end
            end
            local c = e:content()
            for i, line in ipairs(e.lines) do
                for j = 1, #line do
                    draw(c[1] + j - 1, c[2] + i - 1, line:sub(j, j))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self:emit("render %dx%d", self.width, self.height)
    self:emit("%s", string.rep("#", self.width + 2))
    for y = 0, self.height - 1 do
        local row = {}
        for x = 0, self.width - 1 do
            row[#row + 1] = screen[y][x]
        end
        self:emit("#%s#", table.concat(row))
    end
    self:emit("%s", string.rep("#", self.width + 2))
end
function D:command(line)
    local args = split(line, " ")
    local command = table.remove(args, 1)
    if command == "LAYOUT" then
        self:emit("layout %dx%d", self.width, self.height)
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if e.displayed then
                self:emit(
                    "%s%s %d %d %d %d",
                    string.rep(" ", e.depth * 2),
                    e.id,
                    table.unpack(e:border())
                )
            else
                self:emit("%s%s none", string.rep(" ", e.depth * 2), e.id)
            end
        end
    elseif command == "BOX" then
        local e = self.byID[args[1]]
        if not e then
            self:emit("error: unknown element %s", args[1])
            return
        end
        if not e.displayed then
            self:emit("box %s: none", e.id)
            return
        end
        self:emit("box %s", e.id)
        local r = e:border()
        local padding = {
            r[1] + e:n("border-left"),
            r[2] + e:n("border-top"),
            e.cw + e:n("padding-left") + e:n("padding-right"),
            e.ch + e:n("padding-top") + e:n("padding-bottom")
        }
        local names = {"margin", "border", "padding", "content"}
        for i, box in ipairs({e:marginBox(), r, padding, e:content()}) do
            self:emit("%s %d %d %d %d", names[i], table.unpack(box))
        end
    elseif command == "RENDER" then
        self:render()
    elseif command == "HIT" then
        local x, y = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
        if x >= self.width or y >= self.height then
            self:emit("error: point %d %d outside viewport", x, y)
            return
        end
        local found
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if e.displayed then
                local r = e:border()
                if x >= r[1] and x < r[1] + r[3] and y >= r[2] and y < r[2] + r[4] then
                    found = e
                end
            end
        end
        local path = {}
        while found do
            table.insert(path, 1, found.id)
            found = found.parent
        end
        self:emit("hit %d %d: %s", x, y, #path > 0 and table.concat(path, " > ") or "none")
    elseif command == "SET" then
        local e, property = self.byID[args[1]], args[2]
        local value = table.concat(args, " ", 3)
        if not e then
            self:emit("error: unknown element %s", args[1])
            return
        end
        if not initial[property] and not contains(property, "margin", "padding", "border", "gap") then
            self:emit("error: unknown property %s", property)
            return
        end
        local declarations = valid(property, value)
        if not declarations then
            self:emit("error: invalid value for %s: %s", property, value)
            return
        end
        local before = self:snapshot()
        for _, decl in ipairs(declarations) do
            e.inline[decl[1]] = decl[2]
        end
        self:layout()
        self:emit("set %s %s %s: %s", e.id, property, value, self:changed(before))
    elseif command == "VIEWPORT" then
        local w, h = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
        if w < 1 or w > 80 or h < 1 or h > 40 then
            self:emit("error: invalid viewport %d %d", w, h)
            return
        end
        local before = self:snapshot()
        self.width, self.height = w, h
        self:layout()
        self:emit("viewport %d %d: %s", w, h, self:changed(before))
    elseif command == "OVERFLOW" then
        local names = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if e.displayed then
                local overflow = false
                if e.text then
                    overflow = #e.lines > e.ch
                    for _, text in ipairs(e.lines) do
                        overflow = overflow or #text > e.cw
                    end
                else
                    local content = e:content()
                    for _, child in ipairs(e:flow()) do
                        local r = child:marginBox()
                        if
                            r[1] < content[1] or r[2] < content[2] or
                                r[1] + r[3] > content[1] + content[3] or
                                r[2] + r[4] > content[2] + content[4]
                         then
                            overflow = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                if overflow then
                    names[#names + 1] = e.id
                end
            end
        end
        self:emit("overflow: %s", #names > 0 and table.concat(names, " ") or "none")
    else
        self:emit("error: unknown command %s", command)
    end
end
local dimensions = split(io.read("*l"), " ")
D.width, D.height = tonumber(dimensions[1]), tonumber(dimensions[2])
while true do
    local line = io.read("*l")
    if line == "---" then
        break
    end
    local at = line:find(" { ", 1, true)
    local rule = {selectors = split(line:sub(1, at - 1), ", "), declarations = {}}
    for _, part in ipairs(split(line:sub(at + 3, -3), "; ")) do
        local colon = part:find(": ", 1, true)
        local declarations = valid(part:sub(1, colon - 1), part:sub(colon + 2))
        for _, decl in ipairs(declarations or {}) do
            rule.declarations[#rule.declarations + 1] = decl
        end
    end
    D.rules[#D.rules + 1] = rule
end
local stack = {}
while true do
    local line = io.read("*l")
    if line == "===" then
        break
    end
    local indentation = line:match("^ *")
    local depth = #indentation // 2
    local head, text = line:sub(#indentation + 1):match("^([^ ]+) ?(.*)$")
    local kind, rest = head:match("^([^#]+)#(.+)$")
    local parts = split(rest, ".")
    local e =
        setmetatable(
        {
            kind = kind,
            id = parts[1],
            text = text ~= "" and text:sub(2, -2) or nil,
            classes = {},
            inline = {},
            children = {},
            depth = depth,
            index = #D.elements + 1
        },
        Element
    )
    for i = 2, #parts do
        e.classes[parts[i]] = true
    end
    if depth > 0 then
        e.parent = stack[depth]
        e.parent.children[#e.parent.children + 1] = e
    end
    stack[depth + 1] = e
    D.elements[#D.elements + 1] = e
    D.byID[e.id] = e
end
D:layout()
while true do
    local line = io.read("*l")
    if line == "END" then
        break
    end
    D:command(line)
end
if #D.output > 0 then
    io.write(table.concat(D.output, "\n"), "\n")
end
